lina: FYI — noticed shelf-aging on p3x8 nodes in us-west-2. Pod churn high, free full-GPU slots falling from 120 -> 42 in 48h, queue depth up ~18%.

kai: any alerts? which stacks affected?

lina: alert fired (infra/scheduling/high_fragmentation). Mostly dedicated-tenant workloads + small-batch realtime jobs. Latency SLO spikes on large-batch tails.

tanvi: could be the long-running low-utilization jobs that never shrink to slices. We saw similar in oct. Are we still running the 'reserve-shelf' policy?

lina: reserve-shelf is enabled but aging threshold might be too high. Currently config:
```
reserve_shelf:
  age_threshold_hours: 168
  allow_backfill: true
  fragmentation_penalty: 0.8
```
Lowering to 48h would trigger more compaction.

sam: compaction run frequency is also a factor — we pause compaction during peak. If May forecast is up, pausing is hurting.

capacity-bot: Forecast update for us-west-2: +1.2k GPU hours/week starting 2026-05-01 from genai batch and embeddings. 95% CI: +0.9k–+1.6k.

kai: action: let's run a targeted compaction canary on one rack. Lina can you coordinate? Also open a short-term reserved bump request for next 3 weeks.

lina: will do. plan: 1) schedule compaction canary (p3x8-rack-7) tonight 2) reduce age_threshold to 48h in canary 3) enable preemptible backfill for small jobs 4) request +200 reserved GPU hours this week.

tanvi: add a metric to track 'shelf_age_percentiles' and 'backpressure_rate' so we can monitor regressions.

sam: ping @oncall when canary starts; rolling watch required. Also, update cost estimate: bump +200 GPU hours/week ≈ $6.4k/wk (rough), include in finance slack.

lina: will post updates here. if canary shows >30% reduction in queue depth we roll to 3 racks. if not, revert.

capacity-bot: canary scheduled at 1964127200 — will record pre/post metrics.

lina: thanks. tagging followups: #action items: canary run, reserved request, metric dashboard, finance note.

kai: ack :thumbsup:
